name: NEXTDC SC1 Sunshine Coast
notes: NEXTDC lists SC1 at 44 Maud St, Maroochydore with 290+ sqm technical space, 80+ rack capacity and 1MW+ IT capacity; the facility hosts/has direct access to the Sunshine Coast submarine cable landing infrastructure.

name: NEXTDC SC2 Sunshine Coast
notes: NEXTDC lists SC2 Sunshine Coast as a 6MW in-development facility; Architectus describes the DA-approved five-level SC2 centre adjoining SC1 near the Maroochydore international submarine cable landing station, and local reporting says the $200m AI-ready project is under construction at South Sea Islander Way with expected operation in H1 2027.

name: Pulse Data Centre
notes: Pulse DC's official site describes a Toowoomba facility with Tier III design up to 7.5MW, 4,380 sqm technical floor space and potential large-scale expansion up to 50MW; Uptime Institute says phase one provides 2.5MW colocation capacity as part of a three-stage plan to 7.5MW.

name: DigiCo Townsville TSV1 / North Queensland Regional Data Centre
notes: DigiCo lists Townsville TSV1 in its Asia Pacific data-centre portfolio. Data Center Map identifies it at 125-129 Dalrymple Road with 140 racks, N+1 redundancy and 1.2MW power capacity, and records the former iseek North Queensland Regional Data Centre opening in September 2019; CIO reported the original Townsville City Council/JCU NQRDC procurement plan.

name: ONQ Townsville CBD data centre
notes: Aggregator listings identify ONQ Townsville CBD at 1 25/21 Sturt St as an operational TIA-942 Tier 3 colocation facility in Townsville CBD with redundant telecom, power and cooling infrastructure; capacity was not published in reliable primary sources found.

name: QGC Chinchilla control buildings data centre
notes: Hutchinson Builders describes QGC control buildings on the Warrego Highway at Chinchilla that include office space, a data centre, UPS rooms, redundant power systems, redundant chilled water systems for critical data equipment, operations rooms and diesel-generator backup; this is an enterprise/industrial data centre rather than a public colocation facility.
